coverDek: Five prayers for the nights your heart is doing the math on what you lost. Pray one slowly. Then come back tomorrow and pray it again.

points.hook: Lord, You were in the room when they walked out.
paragraphs: I don't need an explanation. I need the truth: I am not what they said when they were done loving me.
You didn't walk out with them. So say it to me again, until I believe it.
points.verseText: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

points.hook: I declare: their leaving does not set my price.
paragraphs: Grief lies. It says this is proof — proof I wasn't enough, proof love doesn't stay. I reject what grief is trying to teach me about my worth.
What God started in me before they arrived is still standing now that they're gone.
points.verseText: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

points.hook: This isn't only about them. And that's allowed.
paragraphs: Some of what I'm carrying is old — a wound this just reopened, not one this caused. I can grieve the person and the pattern at the same time.
Naming that isn't weakness. It's where the healing actually starts.
points.verseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

points.hook: Here's what's happening in your chest right now: it's healing, not breaking.
paragraphs: Pain this sharp means something real was there. A wound only hurts this much where there used to be life.
Let it ache without rushing it shut. What heals slowly tends to heal all the way.
points.verseText: He will wipe every tear from their eyes.

points.hook: Let Me carry what you can't hold tonight.
paragraphs: You don't have to be strong in front of Me. Bring Me the version of you that's still in pieces — I'm not frightened by it.
I'm not finished with your story. I'm restoring it, not replacing it.

cta.closingLine: If even one line reached you, don't pray it once and move on. Come back tomorrow — healing is rarely a moment. It's a practice.
